profile.mfa.requiredByAdmin: Your administrator requires two-factor authentication for admin accounts. Set it up below to use the admin pages.

profile.close.title: Close Account
profile.close.description: Close your account and block sign-in. Only an administrator can restore it.
profile.close.intro: Close your account and sign out everywhere. You won’t be able to sign back in — only an administrator can restore access. Your requests, votes, issues and watch history are kept. Ask an administrator if you also want your personal data erased.
profile.close.confirmPrompt: Type {word} to confirm. This closes your account and signs you out of every device — you won’t be able to sign back in unless an administrator restores it.
profile.close.confirmLabel: Type {word} to confirm closing your account
profile.close.error.retry: Failed to close account. Please try again.
profile.notifications.title: Notification Preferences
profile.notifications.description: Choose which notifications you receive on each channel.
profile.notifications.pushOnly: Browser/device push is the only notification channel available to you right now — enable it from the bell in the top bar. Link your Discord account to add another channel, or ask an admin to configure email delivery.
profile.notifications.issuesHint: Notify me when a user reports an issue or replies to an existing one
profile.notifications.discord.approved: Notify me on Discord when my request is approved
profile.notifications.discord.available: Notify me on Discord when my content is ready to watch
profile.notifications.discord.declined: Notify me on Discord when my request is declined
profile.notifications.email.approved: Email me when my request is approved
profile.notifications.email.available: Email me when my content is ready to watch
profile.notifications.email.declined: Email me when my request is declined
profile.notifications.push.approved: Push notification when my request is approved
profile.notifications.push.available: Push notification when my content is ready to watch
profile.notifications.push.declined: Push notification when my request is declined
profile.notifications.jellyfinEmailHint: Jellyfin accounts don't expose a verified email. Enter an address and we'll send a verification link — notifications start once you click it.
profile.notifications.verificationSent: Verification email sent — check your inbox and click the link.
profile.notifications.syncedHint: Synced from your sign-in provider. Update it there to change where notifications are delivered.
profile.notifications.error.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address
profile.autoRequest.title: Watchlist Auto-Request
profile.autoRequest.description: Request titles automatically when you add them to a watchlist.
profile.autoRequest.summonarrHint: Titles you add to your Summonarr watchlist are requested for you automatically.
profile.autoRequest.plexConnected: New titles on your Plex watchlist are requested periodically.
profile.autoRequest.plexNotConnected: Sign in with Plex once to connect your Plex watchlist.
profile.autoRequest.plexServerOptIn: Turn this on to let your Plex server read your Plex watchlist, or sign in with Plex once.
profile.autoRequest.plexServerConnected: Connected through your server — new titles on your Plex watchlist are requested periodically.
profile.autoRequest.plexServerPrivate: Your Plex watchlist is private — set Watchlist visibility to Friends in Plex privacy settings.
profile.autoRequest.plexServerPending: Your server reads your Plex watchlist if you are one of its Plex friends — otherwise sign in with Plex once.
profile.push.title: Push Devices
profile.push.description: Devices registered for push notifications. Remove any you no longer use.
profile.push.error.remove: Failed to remove device — try again.
profile.calendar.title: Calendar Feed
profile.calendar.description: Upcoming release dates in your own calendar app.
profile.calendar.intro: Subscribe in Google, Apple or Outlook calendar to see release dates for your requests and watchlist — theatrical, digital and physical releases for movies, and air dates for upcoming episodes. Anyone with the link can see these titles, so keep it private.
profile.calendar.copyNow: Copy this link now — it won’t be shown again. Generating a new one turns this one off.
profile.calendar.howTo: Google Calendar: Other calendars → From URL → paste the link. Apple Calendar: File → New Calendar Subscription. Outlook: Add calendar → Subscribe from web. Calendar apps refresh on their own schedule, from every few minutes to about a day.
profile.calendar.lostIt: Lost it? Generate a new one — the old link stops working.
profile.calendar.confirmRegenerate: Generate a new link? Calendars subscribed with the current link stop updating.
profile.calendar.confirmRevoke: Turn off the feed? Calendars subscribed with it stop updating.
profile.calendar.allFeedHint: You manage requests, so a new link also comes with an all-requests feed.
profile.calendar.error.create: Couldn’t create a feed link — try again.
profile.calendar.error.revoke: Couldn’t turn off the feed — try again.
